annotations.exact_quote: LLC utilizes the locality constraints to project each descriptor into its local-coordinate system, and the projected coordinates are integrated by max pooling to generate the final representation.
annotations.reason_zh: LLC将描述子投影到局部坐标系统并池化为最终表示，属于用局部基向量/字典编码样本的表示方法，且与稀疏编码策略比较，符合稀疏表示以基向量表达样本的核心机制。
